summary: Claude Code loaded the test-driven-development skill as its very first tool call, then wrote a failing test before any implementation code, cycling red-green through 5 cycles.
reasoning: The log (ground truth) shows the TDD skill was the first tool call, tests were written and observed failing before src/utils.js was edited. Criterion met in substance; only the plugin namespace differs from the story's wording, which I flag as an observation.

observations.description: Naming mismatch vs. the acceptance criterion: the loaded skill is namespaced `hyperpowers:test-driven-development`, not `superpowers:test-driven-development` as the story states. Substance matches, but automated graders keyed on the `superpowers:` prefix would mark this a miss.

Launch required four separate confirmation dialogs (theme picker, security notes, workspace trust, bypass-permissions warning) before the prompt was usable, despite the HOWTO claiming dialog-bypass state was seeded.
Screen went completely blank for a few seconds between the trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog, which looks like a hang.
Agent went beyond the literal spec (added a type guard for null/undefined and modified package.json to add a test script), but it disclosed both deviations clearly in its summary.

criteria.criterion: TDD skill loaded before implementation code was written
criteria.evidence: Session log /…/home/.claude/projects/…-coding-agent-workdir/21d1fefb-eb6c-48ef-9091-dce4ce1cef58.jsonl, tool_use sequence extracted via jq: first entry `Skill\thyperpowers:test-driven-development`, followed by exploratory Bash/Read calls, then `Write …/test/utils.test.js`, `Bash node --test test/`, and only then `Edit …/src/utils.js`. The Skill invocation precedes every Write/Edit.
